description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price for Turmeric Pander Per 1 Kg Rs. 750 effect from 21.04.2020
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes a price control regulation (maximum retail price for turmeric powder) and carries the force of law. While it names an individual (Maj. Gen. Shantha Dissanayake) in a signing capacity, this is not a government personnel appointment but rather a regulatory action. The content primarily deals with creating a binding legal requirement for businesses, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
